title: Ishakisha ry'inyenyeri rigamije kumenya ukuri
intro: Tekereza uhagaze munsi y'ijuru rinini nijoro, ureba urumuri rumurika rukaza rukerera hanyuma rugashira mu gihe ushaka icyo by'ukuri gikwiriye kwiheberwa. Impande zawe, amashusho acuze ahabwa ishimwe n'amaturo, ariko impamvu isobanutse neza irashidikanya ku mbaraga zayo. Ijwi ritagira ubwoba rigiye kwamagana imigenzo gakondo kandi ryerekeza ku Muremyi w'ijuru n'isi.
clues: Narebye inyenyeri, ukwezi, n'izuba, maze nibwira ko bidashobora kuba Umwami wanjye kuko birenza bikabura.
Nahakanye ku mugaragaro ibyo abantu banjye basengaga bitari Allah, mbahamagarira gusenga Umuremyi wenyine.
Nagiye impaka ku mutegetsi wirata wavugaga ko ari we utanga ubuzima n'urupfu, maze ndamusubiza mvuga ko ari we uzana izuba riturutse iburasirazuba.
Nakubise ibigirwamana ndabimenagura, ibinini muri byo nsigarana gusa kugira ngo abantu babigarukire.
Nafashwe ndacirwa urubanza n'abantu banjye, bavuze ngo twubake inyubako maze banjugunye mu muriro ugurumana.
Narokowe ubwo Allah yategetse umuriro kuba ubukonje n'umutekano kuri njye.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yahanganye n'ugusenga ibigirwamana kandi aganira ku cyo isanzure risobanura

Abayoboke bayobowe banyuze mu nyanja yatandukanyijwe na Allah
Yazuwe mu ijuru ari muzima atabanje gusogongera urupfu
Yaryamanye n'abagenzi mu buvumo imyaka myinshi
